theme.description: Obsidian Minecraft Creator Studio — deep matte obsidian surfaces (#0e1117 / #161b22) paired with vibrant Redstone/Emerald/Lapis Minecraft glow accents (#10b981 emerald, #38bdf8 lapis diamond, #f59e0b gold ore, #ef4444 redstone) and crisp isometric grid lines.

rules.headings: Space Grotesk, font-bold or font-extrabold, tracking-tight, uppercase overlines in JetBrains Mono tracking-[0.2em]
rules.body: DM Sans, font-normal leading-relaxed, text-slate-300 on dark
rules.code_and_keys: JetBrains Mono for identifier IDs (e.g. `custom:ruby_sword`, `minecraft:iron_ingot`), JSON payloads, recipe grids and code preview
rules.prohibitions: Never use Inter for headings. Never exceed text-6xl for desktop hero titles.

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.guarantee: scrim: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(11, 14, 20, 0.85) 0%, rgba(11, 14, 20, 0.95) 100%) with 1px isometric grid backdrop

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand value + generator prompt left, live visual 3x3 crafting grid & element showcase right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — Minecraft Studio preview & feature highlights left, email/password form card right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split auth — modding community tier benefits left, account creation form right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: workspace command center — active mod projects grid, quick AI prompt generator, quota meter & export trigger
entry_surfaces./projects/:id: studio IDE layout — left sidebar category navigator (Items, Blocks, Mobs, Recipes, Armor/Tools, Ores), center canvas editor with live preview, right inspector & code preview
entry_surfaces./pricing: tier matrix — Free vs Creator Pro vs Studio 18+ Modder with Stripe checkout triggers and feature breakdown

image_urls.description: Dark gaming voxel & Minecraft aesthetic moody studio glow backdrop for hero and auth visual panel
Abstract pixel terrain & ore biome preview illustration for world generation ore editor

layout_and_grids.header: Crystal glass sticky bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0E14]/85 border-b border-slate-800/80 px-6 py-4 z-50) with Brand Logo, Forge/Bedrock target badges, Quota Meter pill, Nav links, Pro upgrade button, and User Profile menu
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Tetris Bento: col-span-1 md:col-span-12 gap-6 with Featured AI Generator banner (col-span-12), Project Cards (col-span-12 md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-4), Quota & Export Activity Widget (col-span-12 md:col-span-4)
layout_and_grids.studio_editor_layout: 3-column IDE: Left tree navigator (260px fixed width), Center editor canvas (flex-1 scrollable with custom 3x3 crafting matrix, mob attribute sliders, texture picker, loot tables), Right inspector (340px tabbed Forge Java code / Bedrock JSON manifest & instant download preview)
layout_and_grids.mobile_rules: Left navigator collapses into a mobile slide-out Sheet, right inspector stacks below editor, responsive padding max p-4 on mobile and p-8 on desktop

component_styling_direction.buttons: Pill & Chamfered edges with subtle 1px border. Primary CTA: emerald glow `bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-emerald-950 font-semibold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]`. Secondary: `bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-100 border border-slate-700`. Action destructive: `bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/30`.
component_styling_direction.crafting_grid: 3x3 slot matrix styled with sunken inset borders (`shadow-inner bg-[#090D16] border-2 border-[#1E293B] rounded-lg w-14 h-14 flex items-center justify-center hover:border-emerald-500/60 transition-colors cursor-pointer`). Arrow indicator to output slot with enchanted shimmer effect.
component_styling_direction.item_block_cards: Dark obsidian slate (`bg-[#121824] border border-[#1E293B] rounded-xl p-5 hover:border-emerald-500/40 hover:shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] transition-all`) with voxel icon preview, identifier tag pill, Java/Bedrock compatibility pills.
component_styling_direction.ai_prompt_bar: Command-bar style container (`bg-[#161F30] border-2 border-emerald-500/30 focus-within:border-emerald-400 p-2 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)]`) with preset suggestion chips (`'Mythic Boss & Nether Dagger'`, `'Cosmic Ore with Laser Pickaxe'`, `'Custom Redstone Golem Mob'`, `'Obsidian Armor Set with Speed Buff'`).
component_styling_direction.code_preview_panel: JetBrains Mono tabbed viewer with syntax highlighting emulation for Forge `ModItems.java`, `ModBlocks.java`, `ItemModelGenerator.java` and Bedrock `manifest.json`, `items/ruby_sword.json` with one-click 'Copy' and 'Export .zip / .mcpack' buttons.

micro_interactions: Hover lift on project cards: translateY(-3px) with subtle emerald border bleed
Crafting slot item placement: scale pop spring (scale: [0.85, 1.05, 1])
AI Generating pulse: glowing border sweep along the prompt container
Export download trigger: simulated compilation progress bar with Java/Bedrock pack bundling steps followed by instant file download trigger
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with `prefers-reduced-motion` compliance or standard opacity fades without transforms.

java_mod.bundle_format: .zip containing standard gradle/src directory layout, modid, assets, data, and Java classes ready for gradlew build

bedrock_addon.bundle_format: .mcpack / .mcaddon with valid UUIDs in manifest.json, behavior pack (BP), and resource pack (RP) textures & geometry

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all normal text, 3:1 for large badges)
accessibility.aria_labels: All visual crafting slots, icon selectors, and icon-only download triggers require clear `aria-label` or tooltips

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark mode as primary default by ensuring the <html> tag in `frontend/index.html` has `class="dark"`.
Set `--font-heading: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif;` and `--font-sans: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif;` and `--font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace;` in `@theme inline`.

Implement the 6 Core Mod Element Editors with rich custom UI controls: 1) Items & Weapons (damage, attack speed, durability, special effects), 2) Blocks & Ores (hardness, blast resistance, light emission, drop rules, world gen veins), 3) Mobs/Entities (health, speed, hostile/passive, custom sound/loot, AI behavior goals), 4) Armor & Tool Sets (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, pickaxe, axe, shovel, sword, hoe with armor toughness and set bonus), 5) Custom Crafting & Smelting Recipes (interactive 3x3 drag/click crafting table matrix and furnace smelter), 6) Creative Tab customizer.

Build the AI Mod Prompt Assistant with interactive generation templates that automatically construct all 6 elements when user types a prompt (e.g. 'A Frostburn Dimension mod with Cryo-Ores, Glacial Armor, and Ice Drake Mob').
Support dual export engine: Generate actual downloadable Forge/Fabric source `.zip` and Bedrock `.mcpack` files containing valid directory structures, Java classes, and Bedrock JSON schemas.
Include User Auth with email/password login/register session cookies (`/api/auth/*`) allowing users to save and edit their mod libraries in MongoDB.
Provide Tiered Quotas & Pricing page with Creator Pro / Studio 18+ plan subscription options via simulated Stripe checkout + mock upgrade flow.

Every button, input, tab, crafting slot, and project card MUST have explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="create-mod-button"`, `data-testid="crafting-slot-0"`, `data-testid="export-java-zip"`, `data-testid="export-bedrock-mcpack"`).
All components should be strictly typed TypeScript (`.tsx`) and use preinstalled shadcn/ui components (`@/components/ui/...`) with sonner toasts for actions.
